featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the best time working with genuinely the best event planners
“The Wedding Wale” A.K.A Reetu Jain, Jignesh Chouhan and Team.

They work like a family-they treat clients like a family and in the end we all become a big fat family.

They come on board, understand your vision for the wedding, guide you through and through to ensure the vision is achieved. I had my doubts initially but honestly they delivered.

They have an able experienced team to handle all departments of the wedding be it Hospitality, Logistics, F&B, Decor, Wedding designs and stationery etc.

They introduce you to good vendors be it for your Mehendi artists, make up, decor, photographers, celebrities, Sangeet choreography teams mainly all in sync with your budget. They have no qualms about you making any bookings directly and best part they co-ordinate with all the agencies perfectly on the big day so nothing is out of place.

They work very systematically. They set up the Timeline and Budget allocation chart at the onset. Like they tell you how to go about the wedding, make a timeline of things to do and allocate budgets based on your requirement starting from save the date, pre wedding photo shoot, invites, text messages to guests, artists bookings, venue recces, RSVP’s, food menus basically everything. This helps as you are working well ahead of time, in your stipulated budget and are relaxed.

The good thing about them is they are willing to go the extra mile until you are satisfied or see that smile on the client’s face.

Their USP is their Varmala and couple entries for each event. Irrespective of your budget- they plan in detail and truly make the Varmala and couple entries special and memorable for you. You could book them just for this.

We had endless late night long phone calls , many many meetings, million texts but they were always always available and consistent.

There are many wedding planners out there and tonnes of new ideas in the wedding industry every day. What I figured is on your big day you need a team that you trust and who work for you with a big smile and a warm heart.

I can vouch for the Wedding Wale team on that.

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Babu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Working with TwoFatLadies was honestly one of the best decisions we made. From the very beginning, we bonded over something as simple and fun as sharing the same first name, which instantly made everything feel more personal and easy.

The team is incredibly warm and just get it. Cean is a little firecracker and such a boss woman, Vedika is so determined and a go getter, there was instant comfort knowing they were around taking care of things. Wedding planning can be so overwhelming, but they really made sure we always felt heard and supported. My husband and I were planning everything remotely, and since this was one of the first weddings in our family, we had no idea what we were doing half the time. Having Namrata guide us through it all made such a huge difference.

Dealing with vendors in different languages could have been a nightmare, but Namrata handled it so smoothly. She always made sure our priorities were communicated clearly and a lot of the time she just knew what would matter to us even before we said it. She saved us in so many ways along the way.

The best part was that it never felt like a formal or stressful process, it genuinely felt like planning something with a friend. She was always there to listen, no matter how small or random our concerns were, and never once made us feel silly.

As a bride, you think you’ve imagined your wedding down to every last detail, and there’s always that little bit of stress about how everything will actually turn out. But she truly went above and beyond, our wedding ended up being even better than I ever imagined. She’s so experienced and creative, and I’m honestly so glad we had her by our side because everything felt elevated thanks to her input.

So, so grateful for the team and everything they did to make our wedding what it was ❤️ Hopefully this relationship does not end here….

featured_reviews.name: Bharat
featured_reviews.review_text:
We honestly could not have asked for better wedding planners. They worked closely with us for over six months and supported us through every step of the process. We had zero experience planning a wedding, and their advice was invaluable. They guided us calmly and thoughtfully, helping us make the right decisions without ever pushing their own agenda.

The execution on the day itself was outstanding. Going into the wedding, we had no real idea of how everything would come together, but the moment we walked in, it was beyond anything we could have imagined. Everything ran seamlessly and looked incredible.

They were always super responsive, reliable, and completely trustworthy. They were also very transparent with finances, which gave us a lot of confidence, and they had no issues at all with us using our own vendors. That flexibility meant a lot to us.

Most importantly, they never felt like planners doing a job. They genuinely felt like friends who cared deeply about us and just wanted us to have the best wedding possible. We are incredibly grateful to them and would recommend them without hesitation.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Nigudkar
featured_reviews.review_text:

I would recommend them a hundred times over, without hesitation.
Sonali & Aditya

featured_reviews.name: David McElhinney
featured_reviews.review_text:
We would whole-heartedly recommend using Namrata and the Two Fat Ladies team to help plan your wedding. As a Northern Irish and Indian couple, we were keen to work with planners that had experience planning intercultural marriages, and from the get-go we found Namrata diligent, communicative, approachable, and most importantly, always presenting a calming, relaxed demeanour. The last of these traits prevented the process from ever becoming too overwhelming. Her team, Cean and Vedika, were also fantastic and really helped during the planning process and ensured things moved smoothly on the days of the wedding. They all listened to what we wanted, offered great suggestions and insights, and helped make the wedding an unforgettable experience for us and all our guests.

Though we could cite lots of specific examples of why we were pleased with their work, one in particular stands out. On the day of the Sangeet, there was an unseasonal rain shower at our wedding venue in Goa. We had planned to hold the event on the hotel lawn, but with the rain showing no signs of abating, the Two Fat Ladies team were able to usher in some last-minute changes and stage it in a nearby hall, moving all of the décor, furniture, catering facilities, and DJ equipment (not to mention our guests) into a building that didn’t feel big enough to accommodate it all, shouldering the burden of that stress all the while. The transformation inside the hall was incredible; it was hard to believe it was the same featureless room we had viewed during a hotel visit several months earlier.

You may ask yourself if you even need a planner. Yes, you do. The Two Fat Ladies were worth their weight in gold.

featured_reviews.name: Shubhangam Tekriwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
From the very first conversation to the final moments of our celebrations, working with Two Fat Ladies was nothing short of exceptional. What truly set them apart was the deeply personalized care they showed towards us as a couple—every decision, detail, and suggestion reflected a genuine understanding of our vision, tastes, and priorities as bride and groom.

Their strength in vendor negotiations was remarkable. They consistently secured the best options and value without ever compromising on quality, aesthetics, or experience. It gave us immense confidence knowing that every vendor—from décor to hospitality—was handled with professionalism, firmness, and mutual respect.

Most impressive was their resourcefulness and problem-solving ability. No request was ever “too much” or “not possible.” Whether it was a last-minute change, a unique idea, or a very specific wish close to our hearts, they always found a way to make it happen—calmly, efficiently, and with a smile.

Thanks to them, we were able to truly enjoy our wedding journey stress-free, knowing everything was in safe and capable hands. We couldn’t have asked for a better partner in bringing our dream wedding to life and would recommend them wholeheartedly to any couple looking for excellence, dedication, and heart in their wedding planning.

featured_reviews.name: Sonakshi Malhotra
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are searching the internet to find a good event planner for you and are unsure of how to down-select, here’s what I’d suggest you do: instead of checking the ratings out of 5 or reading all reviews, pause for a second and notice that very rarely do you find lengthy reviews that are positive. Long reviews are more often than not of people venting, uncommon is when someone is just so happy with a service that one takes time to sit down, pen everything they love abut the service/product.
With that, just check the length of reviews 2fatLadies have across media.
You’ll find how much people loved working with them. The common feedback for this team is the “Will be done” attitude, the “calm/happy vibes” that this team brings in, the meticulous OCD manner in which they operate.

Personally, I had hired this team for my wedding. You don’t need to be Mumbai based to enjoy working with them. Their service quality isn’t dependent on proximity to their home base.

Namrata - She is meticulous, hardworking, calm, doesn’t lose her mind when things go wrong and rather operates in a very action oriented manner to help you sort stuff, very quick on her feet (even if you missed something and realize it’s impact on the wedding day, which in my case was food menu, she will immediately think of how to remedy it). What I absolutely adore about her is her ability to listen, process and in most cases somehow read your mind.
I have attached few pictures of what I wanted for my decor - it is going to be hard for you to find which one was my inspo pic and which one is my actual wedding decor - that’s the level they operate at.

Cean - She was my shadow to help w/ the wedding stuff. What ab absolute treat this young lady is. I personally got to learn so much from her all throughout the wedding. How to be polite, push back to vendors, be SUPER calm and incredibly sweet to people while also being a kickass boss lady. She doesn’t need to be told what to do - she just does it pro-actively. A quality I admire so much in her.

The team - thoughtful, kind, warm and professional.

I just cannot recommend them enough.
Just go ahead and book them, you won’t regret.
- Sonakshi

featured_reviews.name: Daniel and Trisha Zeyer-Iyengar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing the team of Two Fat Ladies and specifically Namrata as our wedding planner, is hands down one of the best decisions we have ever made!

We started to look for wedding planners around 1.5 years before our wedding and Namrata stood out to us immediately when we first talked to her about what we had envisioned for our wedding. For us it was important to choose a planner that knows the industry, is organized and most importantly can work with people that live abroad, as we live in Switzerland. And clearly the Two Fat Ladies fulfilled all these criteria.

The entire planning process was pleasant and accompanied by unwavering commitment and determination by the Two Fat Ladies to ensure we would get our dream wedding. Be it through having meetings at any given time (due to the time difference), negotiating with vendors and bringing us the best possible deal out there, and meticulously keeping track of expenses. At any milestone of the planning process, we could trust Namrata to give us a full assessment of the situation by clearly communicating if an idea of ours was feasible and if so, how it would impact on our budget. In the rare cases where something was difficult to achieve, she would figure out a way to make it happen. Throughout the planning process we became more and more secure in our decision to let the Two Fat Ladies handle our wedding. We gave them our full trust and we were not disappointed.

The cherry on top (and in our opinion one of the most important aspects) was their presence and handling of the wedding on the day off. We had a large crowd coming from overseas, many of them being in India for the first time, and we knew we needed someone to hold the ship down and at the same time let us enjoy our special days. And let us tell you they delivered! From the start of the weekend until the end, we were able to enjoy every single second of it without being confronted with issues or unforeseen complications! And only after the wedding was over, we came to know all that Namrata and her team did for us. For example, we had planned a haldi ceremony outside, but alas the weather had other plans. Namrata and her team pulled an all-nighter, moved all the decorations into a beautiful inside area, and decorated the space in such a detailed way that in the end the haldi became one of our absolute favorite events of the weekend.

And besides their commitment to our vision of the perfect wedding and their determination to make it happen, the attention to detail and infusing the entire weekend with the essence of us and our relationship has truly blown us, our families, and our friends away. We cannot stress this enough, their attention to detail was nothing short of incredible. And we are not talking about the general details of an event, we mean the smallest imaginable details that one can easily miss during the wedding but then seeing it on the photos or hearing about it from friends and family that appreciated it, sweetens the memory of the wedding even more.

All in all, Namrata and the team of the Two Fat Ladies have made sure that we have memories that we can cherish for the rest of our lives. From the first stages of planning, through months of preparation, and lastly executing what in our eyes was the perfect wedding. We are grateful and thank them for all they did for us and can highly and warmly recommend Namrata and her team!

TL:DR: Amazing wedding planners. 10/10
If you are looking for a wedding planner that is detailed oriented, very knowledgeable regarding the industry, clear communicators, very organized, can work with couples abroad, amazing at the day-off-handling, and committed to make sure your visions come true, then look no further: The Two Fat Ladies are the planners for you!

If not: Your loss and good luck :)

Daniel & Trisha

P.S. Check out the two Fat Ladies Instagram Highlights to see how the events turned out!
